title: devplat role catalogue and agent execution profiles (devplat.execution_profiles.v1)
description: Platform role catalogue (R6 D6): the kind -> executor map (data form of devorch KIND_AGENT) and one execution profile per role, i.e. how the devplat controller turns a task attempt for that role into a Kubernetes Job. Loaded into the DB roles table at registration; no role literal lives in platform code. Development platform only; NOT a production MERCURY artefact. Spec: development-orchestration 16-agent-execution-and-job-lifecycle.md, 17-multi-project-scheduling.md. Cross-file rules (every profile kind is in the catalogue, every catalogue executor with job=true has a profile) are checked by platform/tools/validate_projects.py.

status.description: Capability status of this file (status vocabulary of the amendment brief).

setup_grace_seconds.description: Added to the wall budget for activeDeadlineSeconds: workspace fetch plus result upload.

ttl_seconds_after_finished.description: Backstop only; the controller deletes a Job after it has collected and persisted the results.

kind_catalogue.description: One entry per task kind. Kinds are the vocabulary of the ported devorch state machine; executors are role ids of this file or the non-Job actors 'operator' and 'mac-validation-queue'.

agent_definition.description: Path of the Claude Code subagent definition, relative to the definition source repository (read at a pinned commit by gen_role_configmap.py).

kinds.description: Kinds this role may execute; must equal the catalogue entries that list the role as executor.

llm.description: true: the main container runs Claude Code headless (claude -p) with this role definition.

extra_disallowed_tools.description: Tools removed on the claude command line in addition to the definition's own disallowedTools (never fewer).

max_wall_minutes.description: Upper bound; the Job deadline uses min(contract budget.max_wall_minutes, this) plus setup_grace_seconds.

max_turns.description: Upper bound for claude --max-turns; min(contract budget.max_turns, this).

network_class.description: none: no egress at all. model-only: model-gateway and artifact store. deps: model-only plus the package-registry proxy.

runtime_class.description: RuntimeClass of the pod. 'default' is accepted only in the reduced-assurance workstation mode (15-platform-architecture.md §7).

writes_allowed.description: false: gitbroker refuses any result bundle with commits beyond the reviewed head and the controller never pushes from this role.

est_cost_usd_p80.description: Planning estimate used for budget reservation at admission (17-multi-project-scheduling.md §6). Not a measurement.

role_id.description: Platform role id. The 'mdev-' prefix of the 12 specialist roles is historical.

job.description: false: completed only by authenticated operator evidence (no Kubernetes Job).

read_only.description: true: contracts of this kind must have allowed_paths [] and gitbroker refuses any commit.

gate.description: Review kinds: the parent gate a COMPLETED subtask of this kind satisfies.
